messages.author: MarcusVickEBC
messages.text:
@vancecookcobxin is it possible to mod in icon-passing. Meaning each other skater on the ice can be passed to by pressing one of the spare buttons? Like X Y Z on the 6 button, or L or R?

Can even make it so LW is always X, C is always Y, RW is always Z. LD is always L. RD is always R.

messages.author: DON DON
messages.text: Duuude thats a flippin great idea

messages.author: MarcusVickEBC
messages.text: Can finally have reliable passing and not just flinging the puck and praying.

messages.author: DON DON
messages.text: I agree. It happens more often the not.  Ill end up passing to the guy that's being double teamed vs the wipe open guy thats on a breakaway

messages.author: vancecookcobxin
messages.text:
I thought about it....kind of like NBA 2k when you are trying to pass to a specific player right and hold the right bumper and it brings up the correct button over the players heads you can pass to? The problem is there is a limited amount of space to actually inject code in the ROM and we would have to configure it to now be 6 buttons instead of 3 (A,B,C) 

I'm not sure if it can be done but I'll check on it

messages.author: DON DON
messages.text: I use a ps controller.  A bumper would work perfect for me.

messages.text: O WOW! I was looking at the wrong place.  But daym that's bad.

messages.text: @GMDS we need a playoff picture update with one week left

messages.author: GMDS
messages.text:
Still tough to Guage with the unknown of unfinished games, ....but looking like this:

Top 5
Taipei
Pitt
Sumter
Thunder
MinnHattrick 

6th to 12 seeds:
Tegucigalpa 
Hamilton
Betty Ford (1st legit playoffs!)
Providence
sugar valley
Maryhill
Woodlynne (finishing?)

Teams Eliminated or virtually are:
Italy
Karolina
Baytown
Richfield 🪖 
Devin hill
Barrie
Inglewood (best season?)

messages.author: GMDS
messages.text:
Based on GM pedigree,  accumulated points currently

13 and 14th seeds
Grand river
Easter island
(Great seasons with expansion rosters)

2 teams with an outside shot, but will need to go on a run, and need tons of help, likely bill deep runners
Valhalla. 487
Autobahn .487

So that leaves 2 spots for the following teams:
Highland. 558
Orange county. 528
Rockford .510
Minnesota. 531
North bay .511
South hills. 545

messages.author: GMDS
messages.text:
Getting all the games in will be the key for these teams, Highland and OC have the inside track there, but on the assumption they all finish, my likely last 2 in are:
Highland
South hills

Orange county had an amazing season, and could still get the #1 pick by playing well

Rockford will be a dangerous bill team (hamilton owns 1st)

Minnesota had a great get right season, and needs a forward infusion

North bay is the shocker of the season. The grand river/lhx returns and much improved Betty Ford cost them a playoff spot. Unholy is smart enough to see th writing on the wall, and may tank the last few non consequential series, and prep for the bill

messages.author: Unholy
messages.text: I’m not smart enough to tank. Also, I don’t really have to tank - I just play normally and the losses keep coming.

messages.author: Unholy
messages.text: Kudos to the teams having great seasons!

messages.author: GMDS
messages.text: No suggestion that you have been, but when there is like 6 games left and your 12 points out, common sense on this nonsensical season may set it
